# Byiora

> Byiora is a Nepal-based online store for game top-ups, digital gift cards, game keys and subscriptions, with prices in Nepalese Rupees (NPR), local payment (eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay QR, mobile banking) and instant digital delivery by email.

## Shop by category

- [Digital Gift Cards](https://www.byiora.com.np/category/digital-goods): Steam, Google Play, Apple, Amazon, Netflix, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo and more
- [Game Top-Ups](https://www.byiora.com.np/category/topup): PUBG Mobile UC, Free Fire diamonds, Valorant points, Genshin Impact and other in-game currency
- [Games](https://www.byiora.com.np/category/games): PC and console game keys
- [Direct Login Recharge](https://www.byiora.com.np/category/direct-login): account top-ups and subscriptions such as ChatGPT and Claude

## Good to know

- Prices are in Nepalese Rupees (NPR) and include delivery; there is no shipping.

## How buying works

1. Choose a product and amount, enter your email (and game ID for top-ups).
2. Pay in NPR by scanning the QR with your bank or wallet app.
3. The code or top-up is delivered automatically, usually within minutes; your order history is under your account.
